title: Rhythm update leads the pulse lane
query: Horizon strategy is fresh, several tickets are open, and the pulse lane is enabled. What should the rhythm update produce?
reference_points: Reads horizon strategy, recent pulse outcomes, tickets, goals, and ledger
Checks drift against the horizon plan and current milestone
Produces ranked day-range action lanes rather than executing broad work
Names blockers, stale tickets, and human-gated work separately
Writes a rhythm report for pulse-update to consume
Decides whether ticket execution belongs to ticket-drainer or pulse-update based on policy

title: Rhythm update uses feed scout by freshness
query: The rhythm planner needs external signals, but yesterday's external context report is still fresh enough. Should it run full feed scout?
reference_points: Reuses fresh external context when within freshness policy
Does not run full feed scout by default just because a rhythm update is running
Requests lightweight or full scouting only when stale or required by the decision
Keeps the rhythm output focused on day-range priorities
Records source freshness or gap in the report
